questions.question:
Choose the option that is the indirect form of the sentence.

A new student said to me, "Where is the Principal's office?"

options.text: A new student asked me where the Principal's office is.
A new student asked me where is the Principal's office.
A new student asked me where the Principal's office was.
A new student said to me where the Principal's office was.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 3) i.e. a new student asked me where the Principal's office was.**

 
• when direct speech is in interrogation form **'said to'** is changed into **'asked'**.
 
• And the present tense of the sentence is also changed into the **past tense**.
 
• And the** interrogative sentence** is changed into the assertive sentence.
 
• All these rules are followed in option 3), hence, it is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Choose the option that is the passive form of the sentence.**

The chief guest gave prizes to the children.

options.text: The children are given prizes by the chief guest.
The children were given prizes by the chief guest.
The children were being given prizes by the chief guest.
The children was given prizes by the chief guest.

questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 2.**
 
• When changing active sentence to its passive form, subject and object interchange their places.
 
• Option 1 is wrong because the sentence is in the present tense but the given active sentence is in past tense. Tense remains the same in both sentences.
 
• Option 4 is wrong because the subject 'children' is in plural form so it is followed by the plural verb i.e. 'were'.
 
• Option 3 is wrong because 'being' is used while making the passive voice of continuous tenses but the given sentence is in past indefinite.
 
• **Therefore Option 2 'The children were given prizes by the chief guest' is the correct answer.**

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the zstatements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All knifes are axes.

All axes are swords.

All saws are swords.

**Conclusions:**

I. All swords are knifes.

II. Some axes are saws.

III. No axe is saw.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Either conclusion II or III follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Veen diagram is given below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/804f1f772f05c7f57b1074c82e53e2e474ea5333190b3fdeb2a6d6b856efd8d0.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All swords are knife → False (some swords are knives is true)

II. Some axes are saws → False (It is possible but not definite).

III. No axe is saw → False (It is possible but not definite).

So, conclusion II and III are complementary to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is Either conclusion II or III follows.

A shopkeeper bought an article for Rs.100 and marked its price 25% above the cost price. How much discount percentage should be announcing in order to make a profit of 15%?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

CP = Rs.100

MP = 100 + 100 × 25/100 = 125

Profit % = 15% = 15/100 = 3/20

CP/SP = 20/23

20 units = 100

1 unit = 5

SP (23 units) = 5 × 23 = Rs.115

Discount% calculation,

115 = 125 × (100 - x)/100

⇒ X = 8%

**∴ The answer is 8%.**

questions.question: The area of a sector of a circle with central angle 60° is A. The circumference of the circle is C. Then A is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The total area of a circle in terms of circumference C is given directly by Aₜₒₜₐₗ = C² / 4π.

A sector with a central angle of 60° covers exactly 60° ÷ 360° = 1/6 of the total area of the circle.

Area of sector (A) = (1/6) × (C² / 4π) = C² / 24π.

**∴ The correct answer is C² / 24π.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/971bcfb620aaaf4cfad8c744b8bd778e33f9cd4efcff563f4ebaa06489a0230d.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ Central angle of the sector (θ) = 60°

⇒ Circumference of the circle = C

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Circumference of a circle, C = 2πr (where r is the radius)

⇒ Area of a sector, A = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ From the circumference formula, we find the radius in terms of C:

⇒ r = C / 2π

⇒ Substitute the values of r and θ into the area formula:

⇒ A = (60° ÷ 360°) × π × (C / 2π)²

⇒ A = (1 / 6) × π × (C² / 4π²)

⇒ The π in the numerator cancels out with one π in the denominator:

⇒ A = (1 / 6) × (C² / 4π)

⇒ A = C² / 24π

**∴ The correct answer is C² / 24π.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Complete Circle

The total area enclosed by a circle corresponds to a central angle of 360° and is given by A = πr².

Length of an Arc

The length of an arc (l) forming a central angle θ is given by l = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr.

Area of a Circular Segment

The area of a minor segment is obtained by subtracting the area of the corresponding triangle from the total area of the sector.

questions.question: A borrowed a sum of Rs. 3000 from his friend B on 31 December 2007 on the condition that he would return the same after one year with simple interest at 15% per annum. However, A gets into a position of returning the sum on 31 august 2008. How much amount had A to return to B?
questions.solution:
Time = from 1st January 2008 to 31st august 2008

T = 8 months or 2/3 year

Simple interest = P × R × T/100

SI = [3000 × 15 × (2/3)]/100 = Rs.300

The amount that is to be returned by A = P + SI

⇒ 3000 + 300 = Rs.3300

questions.question: A milkman uses three containers for selling milk, their capacities being 40 L, 30 L and 20 L respectively. Percentage change in cost = (1.3662RA - RA)/RA × 100 = 36.62%

questions.question: A and S are two points on a circle with centre O. AT is a tangent, such that ∠SAT = 45°. N is a point on OA, such that SN = 10 cm. The length of the median OM of ΔSON is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠SAT = 45° 

SN = 10 cm

**Concept used:**

**1.** The length of the median drawn from the vertex of the right angle is half the length of the triangle's hypotenuse.

**2.** The angle between the tangent and the line joining the center of a circle and the point of contact of the tangent to the circle is equal to 90°.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e4b5a9cdc1ca30f925ae986f84cbd2bb17970c13e7c1845a81cb860bd3ccf98.png] 

As AT is the tangent,

∠OAT = 90°

Again ∠SAT = 45°

∴ ∠OAS = 90° - 45° = 45°

In ΔOAS,

OA = OS = Radius

∠OAS = ∠OSA = 45°

Then ∠NOS = 180° - 45° - 45° = 90°

⇒ ΔSON is a right-angles triangle

Thus, OM = SN/2

⇒ OM = 10/2 = 5 cm

**∴ The length of the median OM of ΔSON is 5 cm.**

b² = a² + c²

c² = b² - a²

 = 3b² (- 24a² + 7a²)/8 = 3b² + 17.n.a²

Hence, n = - (1/8)

questions.question: The High Yielding Varieties (HYVs) of wheat were first developed in ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. **__Mexico.__**

 
• **In Mexico, Prof. Norman Borlaug and his associates developed new varieties of wheat which were early-maturing, highly productive and disease resistant and these varieties were imported and planted in selected regions of India having adequate irrigation facilities. **
 
• It was conclusively demonstrated that the yields from the new varieties exceeded 25 to 100 per cent compared to the yields from traditional varieties.
 
• High Yielding Variety Seeds (HYV seeds) are seeds that are of better quality than normal quality seeds.
 
• The produce from these seeds is a bit more compared to the normal ones.
 
• These seeds are a better option of seeds in order to obtain a healthy and surplus crop.
 
• These seeds have a good immune system to fight with insects and other diseases.

questions.question: Who among the following is also known as the founder of macroeconomics as a separate discipline?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. **__John Maynard Keynes.__**

 
• Macroeconomics is a branch of economics that studies how an overall economy—the market systems that operate on a large scale—behaves.
 
• Macroeconomics studies economy-wide phenomena such as inflation, price levels, rate of economic growth, national income, gross domestic product (GDP), and changes in unemployment.
 
• **Macroeconomics, as it is in its modern form, is often defined as starting with John Maynard Keynes and the publication of his book The General Theory of Employment, Interest, and Money in 1936. **

questions.question: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi scheme, announced in the Interim Budget 2019, aims at ________.

options.text: Providing medical insurance for small farmer families
Ensuring minimum income for farmer families who owns cultivable land.
Ensuring effective implementation of minimum support prices for all edible crops
Providing life insurance for small and marginal farmers

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e.__** ensuring a minimum income for farmer families who own up to two hectares of cultivable land.**__

 
• Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN):
 
• **Scheme Type:** Central Sector Scheme.
 
• **Ministry:** Ministry of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare.
 
• **Launched Year:** 2019
 
• **Place of Launch:** Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh
 
• **Beneficiaries:** All farmers irrespective of landholding (earlier land up to 2 hectares) are eligible for financial support.
 
• **Financial Support:** 6000 Rs. in three equal instalments of Rs.2000/- each every four months.
 
• Funds will be directly transferred to the bank account of the beneficiaries under the direct benefit scheme.
 
• **Budget allocation:** 20,000 crore for 2018-19, 75,000 crores for 2019-20.

questions.question: The Election Commission of India recently launched a mobile app for enabling citizens to report the Model Code of Conduct and Expenditure violations during the elections. The app has been named as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. __**cVigil.**__

 
• **Election Commission has launched a mobile application named ‘cVigil’ for citizens to share proof of malpractices by political parties, their candidates and activists at the time of 17th Loksabha Elections**
 
• The application facilitates the sharing of geo-tagged photographic and video evidence without disclosing the sender’s identity.

questions.question: The 2019 Abel Prize has been awarded to ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. **__Karen Uhlenbeck.__**

 
• Mathematician Karen Uhlenbeck received the 2019 Able Prize in Mathematics.
 
• **Karen Uhlenbeck was the first woman to be awarded the Abel Prize in history.**
 
• The Abel Prize is an annual prize awarded by the King of Norway to excellent mathematicians.
 
• It is named after the famous Norwegian mathematician Niels Henrik Abel.
 
• Karen Uhlenbeck, a professor at the University of Texas won the prize for her pioneering achievements in geometric partial differential equations, gauge theory and integrable systems, and for the fundamental impact of her work on analysis, geometry and mathematical physics.

questions.question: Under the Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation (SATAT) scheme, _______ is being promoted as an alternative transport fuel.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. **__compressed biogas__**

 
• Union Petroleum Minister launched 'SATAT' initiative to promote **Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG)** as an alternative fuel.
 
• The initiative is aimed at providing a **Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation (SATAT) **as a developmental effort that would benefit both vehicle-users as well as farmers and entrepreneurs.
 
• The use of CBG will also help bring down dependency on crude oil imports.
 
• Shri Dharmendra Pradhan is the Union Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas & Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
